name: FJSP-DMPBP
description: This dataset contains the 35 benchmark instances used in the manuscript "Exact CP and MILP formulations for flexible job shop scheduling with dual-mode parallel batch processing" (FJSP-DMPBP), together with the preprocessing scripts, the preprocessed solver input files in IBM ILOG OPL format, and the Gantt-chart outputs of the schedules illustrated in the paper. In FJSP-DMPBP, three operation types coexist: solo operations; MPBPOs (mandatory parallel-batch operations that must be processed together in one p-batch task); and FPBPOs (flexible parallel-batch operations that may be grouped into one or several p-batch tasks, or processed individually). A p-batch task starts and finishes simultaneously and its processing time equals the maximum processing time of its members on that machine; the objective is to minimise the makespan. The 35 instances are organised into three groups (gsfjs01–gsfjs10, gmfjs01–gmfjs10, gmk01–gmk15) and were generated from Fdata (Bagheri et al., 2010) and BRdata (Brandimarte, 1993). For each instance, solver input files are provided for five exact formulations: three CP models (Baseline-CP, Sync-CP, USR-CP) and two MILP models (Baseline-MILP, EMILP). The two Python scripts that generate the solver input files from the source workbooks are included.
